delta.comment: CORRECTION 2026-08-17 (Stage, post-Orchestrator review; appended, not erased). Two P1 safety/policy defects found after the original PASS verdict, both corrected in place across plan, hardening, review, deliberation, memory and tasks. C1 out-of-repository backup -> contained in-repo backup behind six empirically verified containment gates (H4 rewritten). C2 automatic destructive rollback -> H16 preserve-and-halt, evidence-first, operator-gated failure recovery. One new hazard found during the correction review and closed (F12: git clean -x/-X would destroy the gitignored backup). Hardening is now H1-H16. Multi-persona adversarial review re-run against the corrected safety contract (personas 7-12): five P1 findings raised, ALL RESOLVED; one P2 accepted with gated mitigation (F13 CLI-managed session-state durability -- evidence shows 27 session dirs persisting since 2026-04-22, mitigated by pre-T006 re-assertion, H15 preservation, and .autoharness/staging/ as documented fallback). Correction-pass verdict: PASS, 0 unresolved P0, 0 unresolved P1. 138-S remains queued and is now shippable; task count, dependency order, sizes and complexities are unchanged.

CANCELLED BY OPERATOR SCOPE CORRECTION (2026-08-18). Not a quality failure. Operator ruled that `.backlogit` remains an acceptable, supported Backlogit workspace directory; `.backlog` is the default for NEW workspaces only; existing workspaces (including this repository) do NOT need migration. The live self-migration premise is therefore withdrawn. 129-F and 129.001-T..129.009-T moved to `rejected` via the only supported path (queued -> active -> review -> rejected; `queued -> rejected` is rejected by the validate_status_transition hook, and `done`/`archived` would falsely assert completion). No task was executed; no filesystem or config root was mutated. Shipment 138-S is to be ABANDONED by Ship (Stage must not claim). Prior plan/hardening/review/deliberation evidence preserved append-only with supersession banners; the PASS verdict stands as issued and is not retracted. Decision artifact: docs/decisions/2026-08-18-backlogit-legacy-root-support-operator-scope-correction.md. Already-shipped product surface 126-F/135-S (PR #345, merge 9851cc3) is unaffected and remains correct.
